objective: Extend the Agent Host runner contract so backend verification commands can run in a declared dependency-satisfied backend Python environment instead of raw system Python. This must prevent false verifier failures like PR #90, where system Python lacked fastapi while backend/requirements.txt plus pytest made the root verifier pass. Implement the generic runner/test-env contract on the existing PR #83 runner-hardening branch with focused tests and exact run artifacts.

temporary backend env with backend/requirements.txt plus pytest ran tests/test_telegram_miniapp_auth.py -q -> 8 passed

known_evidence.runner_gap: Verification commands currently run as raw shell/system Python unless a task author manually embeds venv setup in the command. This causes false failed Control Plane states and manual artifact relays.

required_behavior: Add an explicit runner contract for backend Python verification, preferably via an envelope field such as verification_environment=backend_python, backend_test_environment_required=true, or structured verification command entries with environment=backend_python.

The backend verification environment must be temporary, live under the task artifact/work area, install backend/requirements.txt plus pytest, run requested backend verifier commands with the environment python, and be removed or excluded from committed changes.
Do not silently rewrite all python3 commands. The backend environment must be opt-in and recorded in result metadata so future envelopes can be explicit and auditable.
If backend/requirements.txt is missing or install fails, classify the blocker as backend_test_environment_failed with command/log proof instead of reporting a vague runtime_error.

The result must record system_python_backend_deps_missing when raw system Python lacks declared backend deps, but must not treat that alone as task failure when the declared backend verification environment succeeds.
Push only branch p0/agent-host-runner-contract-hardening-2026-06-30 with normal non-force push.
